form.alreadySubscribed: You are already in. Nothing to do.
form.confirmationSent: Success! Now check your inbox and confirm the address.
form.error: That did not send. Try again, or email hello@saasyland.com.
form.label: Email address

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.description: Confirm your subscription to the SaaSy Land build log.

confirmed.title: You are in.
confirmed.body: The address is confirmed. From here you get the build log: what shipped, the decisions behind it, and the things that did not work.
confirmed.note: Every email has an unsubscribe link. One click and you are off the list.

expired.title: That link is spent.
expired.body: Confirmation links last 24 hours and work once. This one has expired or has already been used, so the address is not confirmed yet.
expired.note: Sign up again from the footer and a fresh link lands in your inbox in about a minute.

unsubscribe.title: You are off the list.
unsubscribe.description: Unsubscribe from the SaaSy Land build log.
unsubscribe.body: That address will not get another build log email. No confirmation needed and nothing else to click.
unsubscribe.note: Transactional email about an account or a purchase is separate and still arrives, because that is mail you asked for by buying something.
unsubscribe.resubscribe: Changed your mind? Sign up again from the footer
